Existing PageConfig.grants and pending Command Gateway names resemble required foundations but implement different semantics; they cannot prove inherited space ACL or authenticated Wiki commands.
Textual Note title/alias first-match lookup can silently choose the wrong Doc; stable Wiki alias migration must keep unknown/ambiguous links unresolved.
Copying content into Wiki metadata, storing a second editor state or rebuilding pins as copies violates the first DoD even if the visible UI looks correct.

Granting target access from shared space membership or move review leaks private leaf/ancestor titles, counts, breadcrumbs, facets, history or agent context; each projection requires current direct target constraints.
Unfenced CAS/review epoch or restore snapshot could orphan subtrees, replay old ACL or roll back Doc body. Restore must create a new tree revision under current policy only.
Global search registry catches provider failure as empty; Wiki denied/offline/error states must remain distinguishable from empty permitted results.
Surface registry uniqueness and route/panel persistence require a common shell-owner patch; a parallel Wiki shell or duplicate contribution conflicts with existing mechanisms.
Concurrent root integration may invalidate line ranges/hashes; this working-tree preflight is not a clean input_revision feature receipt.
No runtime gate has run here. Dependency status, central foundation availability outside inspected seams, tested provider behavior and packet acceptance remain unverified, not N/A.
